service.name: Live music for baby showers and bridal showers
service.serviceType: A guitarist, a Spanish guitarist, a singer with a guitar or a jazz duo for baby showers, bridal showers and couples showers
service.description: Live music for a baby shower or a bridal shower across Denver and the Front Range: one guitarist or a jazz duo playing the standards at 65 to 72 dBA under the meal at home, in a garden or in a private dining space, a singer with a guitar taking the guest of honor's requests, and the one song the afternoon is built around learned for the day, with sound support sized to the space and one personal contact.

faqs.q: Can you play live music at a baby shower?
faqs.a: Yes. Most baby showers book one guitar, a jazz guitarist or a Spanish guitarist playing under the meal, and a singer with a guitar takes the guest of honor's requests where the host wants a voice in the afternoon. It's booked through Signet Artists in Denver.

faqs.q: How loud is it, and how much space does it need?
faqs.a: About the level of the conversation at the table, so grandmothers and friends hear each other across it. One guitar takes about 6 by 4 feet on one circuit and 45 minutes to set up, and a duo 8 by 6, in the corner of a dining space or under cover in a garden. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through the breaks. A certificate of insurance and a W-9 come with the quote if the venue asks.

faqs.q: Can the music work outdoors in a garden?
faqs.a: Yes, under cover and out of direct sun, with power run to it. Where there's no socket, a guitarist can play with a battery-powered system.
